ja: • 第08MS小隊に登場した陸戦型ガンダム改修機Ez8をHGUCで新規立体化。
• 最新のHGUC技術を盛り込み、アクション性能とプロポーションを両立。
• シールドのほか、ビームライフルと100ｍｍマシンガンが付属。
• パラシュートパックは脱着可能。別売りのHGUC 1/144 陸戦型ガンダムのコンテナと差し替え可能。
en: • The ground battle type Gundam modified Ez8 that appeared in the 08th MS platoon has been made into a new three-dimensional model using HGUC.
• Incorporates the latest HGUC technology to achieve both action performance and proportions.
• In addition to Seal, a beam rifle and 100mm machine gun are included.
• Parachute pack is removable. Can be replaced with the HGUC 1/144 Ground Type Gundam container sold separately.
